author: skyzhishui
description: 增强表情包系统：<sticker_plus>情绪</sticker_plus> 标签（AI 给出情绪关键词，由 LLM 结合最近对话从图库候选描述中选图并直接发送，与主模型异步；发送记录以 <system_reminder> 注入 AI 历史上下文，QQ 为收藏表情样式 sub_type=1）、聊天表情自动偷取入库（可配置入库需审核，默认需人工启用；WebUI 可开关）、VLM 自动打标（画面描述 + 20 类情绪标签，打标与选图模型可分别配置）、满额淘汰与防重复使用；自带 WebUI 管理页（预览 / 编辑 / 禁用 / 上传 / 审核）。使用前请先在插件页禁用内置「默认表情包」插件。

en.description: Enhanced emoji system: the <sticker_plus>emotion</sticker_plus> tag (AI gives an emotion keyword, a selection LLM picks from library candidates with recent-chat context and sends it directly, async from the main model; the send record is injected into the AI's history as a <system_reminder>, emoji-style image on QQ, native sticker on Telegram), automatic emoji stealing from chat (optionally landing disabled pending manual approval, on by default; toggleable in WebUI), VLM auto-tagging (description + 20 emotion labels; tagging and selection models are configured separately), capacity eviction and anti-repeat usage; ships a WebUI management page (preview / edit / disable / upload / review). Disable the built-in sticker plugin before enabling this one.
